instructions: Demo plug-in: generate with Scenario models and place the results in the scene. Scene tools are in the catalog: demo_tools_search, then demo_tool_execute_<read|write|delete>.

tools.name: demo_status
tools.title: Status
tools.description:
Who is signed in and the project that receives generations. Does not change anything; use demo_generate to create.
Returns: the account, the project and the spending limits.

tools.name: demo_generate
tools.title: Generate
tools.description:
Generates an image with a Scenario model and imports it. Paid: check the price with the model's estimate first. Does not edit existing assets; use demo_object_set for that.
Returns: the asset path and the job id.

model_id.description: The Scenario model, such as model_example.

tools.name: demo_tools_list
tools.title: List tools
tools.description:
Lists the tools served through the catalog, by group.
Returns: each tool's name, title and one-line summary.

tools.name: demo_tools_search
tools.title: Search tools
tools.description:
Finds catalog tools by words in their name or description.
Returns: the matching tools with their input schemas.

tools.name: demo_tool_execute_read
tools.title: Run a read tool
tools.description:
Runs a read-only catalog tool. Use demo_tool_execute_write for one that changes the scene.
Returns: the tool's own result.

tools.name: demo_tool_execute_write
tools.title: Run a write tool
tools.description:
Runs a catalog tool that changes the scene but deletes nothing. Use demo_tool_execute_delete for one that deletes.
Returns: the tool's own result.

tools.name: demo_tool_execute_delete
tools.title: Run a delete tool
tools.description:
Runs a catalog tool that deletes.
Returns: the tool's own result.

tools.name: demo_object_get
tools.title: Get an object
tools.description:
One scene object with its transform and components.
Returns: the object's path, transform and components.

tools.name: demo_object_set
tools.title: Change an object
tools.description:
Changes an object's name, parent or transform.
Returns: the object's path and new transform.

tools.name: demo_object_delete
tools.title: Delete an object
tools.description:
Deletes a scene object, as one Undo step.
Returns: the deleted object's path.
